pages.text: 野生动物园的车行区到啦！入口处停着一排排彩色的电瓶车，有蓝色的、绿色的、黄色的，每辆车都有两排座位。咘咘拉着爸爸妈妈的手，蹦蹦跳跳地跑过去：「我要坐那辆蓝色的！」Coco 跟在后面，兴奋地说：「Safari ride! This is going to be amazing!」
pages.text_en: They arrived at the safari drive-through zone! Rows of colorful electric carts lined the entrance — blue ones, green ones, yellow ones — each with two rows of seats. Bubu tugged Dad and Mom's hands, bouncing toward them: "I want the blue one!" Coco followed excitedly: "Safari ride! This is going to be amazing!"

pages.text: 一家人上了车！咘咘坐在前排中间，爸爸在左边，妈妈在右边。NOMI 和 Coco 坐在后排，NONO 站在车顶的小栏杆上当瞭望员。动物园的工作人员——一只大象叔叔——递过来一筐胡萝卜和青菜：「准备好了吗？出发！」
pages.text_en: Everyone hopped on! Bubu sat in the front row middle, Dad on the left, Mom on the right. NOMI and Coco took the back row, while NONO perched on the cart's little railing as lookout. A zookeeper — a big friendly elephant — handed them a basket of carrots and vegetables: "Ready? Let's go!"

pages.text: 第一站——鸵鸟区！两只高高的鸵鸟伸长脖子朝电瓶车走过来，大眼睛盯着咘咘手里的胡萝卜。咘咘举着胡萝卜，又想喂又有点害怕，往妈妈怀里缩了缩。鸵鸟一口就叼走了胡萝卜！「啊！好快！」Coco 在后面拍手：「That's an ostrich! So tall!」
pages.text_en: First stop — the ostrich zone! Two tall ostriches stretched their long necks toward the cart, their big eyes fixed on Bubu's carrot. Bubu held it up, half excited and half scared, shrinking toward Mom. The ostrich snatched the carrot in one swift bite! "Ah! So fast!" Coco clapped from behind: "That's an ostrich! So tall!"

pages.text: 电瓶车慢慢开进羊驼区。三只毛茸茸的羊驼围过来，温柔地低头吃咘咘手里的青菜。咘咘小心翼翼地摸了摸羊驼的毛：「好软！跟云朵一样！」爸爸笑着说：「它们是不是很温柔呀？」羊驼嚼着青菜，冲咘咘眨了眨眼睛。
pages.text_en: The cart rolled slowly into the alpaca zone. Three fluffy alpacas gathered around, gently lowering their heads to eat the vegetables from Bubu's hand. Bubu carefully touched an alpaca's wool: "So soft! Like clouds!" Dad smiled: "Aren't they gentle?" The alpaca munched away, blinking at Bubu.

pages.text: 经过一个小湖，一群白天鹅优雅地游了过来。咘咘把一片菜叶轻轻放在水边，天鹅伸长脖子，轻轻叼走了菜叶，动作好优雅。Coco 看得入迷：「Swan! So graceful!」NONO 也飞到湖边，和天鹅们打了个招呼，叽叽喳喳像在聊天。
pages.text_en: Passing a small lake, a flock of white swans glided over gracefully. Bubu gently placed a leaf by the water's edge. A swan stretched its neck and delicately picked up the leaf — so elegant. Coco was mesmerized: "Swan! So graceful!" NONO flew down to the lakeside too, chirping as if chatting with the swans.

pages.text: 小马区到了！一匹棕色的小马走到车边，咘咘递上一根胡萝卜。小马张嘴嚼了起来——嘎嘣嘎嘣，嘎嘣嘎嘣！声音好响好好笑！咘咘捂着嘴巴笑弯了腰：「它吃东西好大声呀！」妈妈也忍不住笑了。
pages.text_en: The pony zone! A brown pony walked up to the cart, and Bubu offered a carrot. The pony chomped away — crunch crunch, crunch crunch! So loud and funny! Bubu covered her mouth, laughing so hard she bent over: "It eats so loudly!" Mom couldn't help laughing too.

pages.text: 前面是骆驼！一只大骆驼低下头，张开大嘴巴，伸出长长的舌头来舔胡萝卜。咘咘瞪大了眼睛：「哇，嘴巴好大！舌头好长！」NOMI 在后排抱着 Coco 的胳膊，小声说：「有点吓人……」Coco 拍拍 NOMI：「Don't worry, it's friendly!」
pages.text_en: Next — camels! A big camel lowered its head, opening its huge mouth and sticking out a very long tongue to lick the carrot. Bubu's eyes went wide: "Wow, such a big mouth! Such a long tongue!" NOMI grabbed Coco's arm from the back row, whispering: "A little scary..." Coco patted NOMI: "Don't worry, it's friendly!"

pages.text: 电瓶车经过一片大水塘，爸爸指着远处说：「看！河马！」咘咘顺着爸爸手指的方向看过去——水面上只露出两只眼睛和一个圆圆的鼻子，其他什么都看不到。「它在泡澡吗？」咘咘歪着头问。「对呀，河马最喜欢泡在水里凉快啦！」
pages.text_en: The cart passed a large pond. Dad pointed ahead: "Look! Hippos!" Bubu looked where Dad was pointing — only two eyes and a round nose peeked above the water, everything else hidden. "Is it taking a bath?" Bubu tilted her head. "Yes! Hippos love soaking in water to stay cool!"

pages.text: 到了浣熊展区！围栏里有好多灰棕色的小浣熊，圆滚滚的，每只都有黑色的眼罩花纹和条纹尾巴。NOMI 一看到它们就站了起来，尾巴摇得停不下来：「看！都是我的家人！」咘咘拿出一块小饼干，往围栏里丢了进去——
pages.text_en: The raccoon zone! Inside the fence were lots of chubby little raccoons, each with black mask markings and striped tails. NOMI stood up the moment she saw them, tail wagging non-stop: "Look! They're all my family!" Bubu took out a small cookie and tossed it over the fence —

pages.text: 哗——所有小浣熊全冲过来了！它们用胖乎乎的小爪子互相推搡着抢那块饼干。「这是我的！」「不，是我的！」「我先看到的！」小浣熊们抢成一团，圆滚滚的屁股挤来挤去。NOMI 看得又骄傲又好笑，眼睛都笑弯了：「它们好可爱！跟我小时候一模一样！」
pages.text_en: Whoosh — all the raccoons dashed over! They pushed each other with their chubby little paws, scrambling for the cookie. "It's mine!" "No, mine!" "I saw it first!" The raccoons tumbled together, their round bottoms bumping into each other. NOMI watched with pride and laughter, eyes crinkled with joy: "They're so cute! Just like me when I was little!"

pages.text: 一只最小的浣熊终于抢到了饼干，抱在怀里蹲在角落里小口小口地啃。其他浣熊围着它，眼巴巴地看着。咘咘赶紧又丢了几块饼干进去：「别抢啦！每个都有！」Coco 笑着说：「They're so funny! Just like NOMI!」NOMI 不好意思地摸摸鼻子。
pages.text_en: The smallest raccoon finally got the cookie, hugging it to its chest and nibbling in a corner. The others gathered around, watching longingly. Bubu quickly tossed in more cookies: "Don't fight! There's enough for everyone!" Coco laughed: "They're so funny! Just like NOMI!" NOMI rubbed her nose shyly.

pages.text: 电瓶车缓缓开回了出口。咘咘回头看，远远的，小浣熊们还站在围栏边，举着小爪子摇啊摇，好像在说再见。咘咘也挥挥手：「再见！下次我再来喂你们！」夕阳洒在动物园的草地上，今天真是太开心了。NOMI 轻轻说：「下次来，我要给它们带更多饼干。」
pages.text_en: The cart slowly rolled back to the exit. Bubu turned around — far away, the little raccoons still stood by the fence, waving their tiny paws as if saying goodbye. Bubu waved back: "Bye bye! I'll come feed you again!" Sunset bathed the zoo's meadow in gold. What a wonderful day. NOMI whispered: "Next time, I'll bring them even more cookies."
